name: fmp_commodity_historical
description:
Daily end-of-day price history for one commodity from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP).
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/historical-price-eod/full as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): symbol* (FMP commodity symbol, e.g. GCUSD).
For the latest quote use fmp_commodity_quote; for symbols fmp_commodity_list.
Example: {"symbol": "GCUSD"}

symbol.description: FMP commodity symbol (e.g. GCUSD for gold)
